candidate.selection_reason: User-configurable options -> new Remarkable() -> creates parser with potentially unsafe html setting
candidate.source_summary: Configuration options loaded from meta.settings.get('markdown') via admin interface. The 'html' field defaults to false but can be set to true via admin configuration.
candidate.sink_summary: parser.render(raw) in markdownify function, which processes user post content and signatures via filter:post.parse and filter:post.parseSignature hooks.
candidate.guard_summary: Default configuration has html:false. Admin can enable html via settings. No input sanitization or HTML escaping visible in the markdownify path. Remarkable library's HTML rendering behavior depends on its html option.
candidate.risk_pattern: Admin-configurable HTML rendering enabled in markdown parser allows potential XSS if untrusted user content is processed with html:true setting.
candidate.context_summary: Parser initialized with user-configurable options including 'html' flag. Used to render user posts and signatures via hook system.
unresolved_facts: Whether admin interface properly validates/sanitizes HTML configuration
Whether Remarkable library safely handles HTML when html:true
Whether other input sanitization occurs before markdownify

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
target_cwe.description: The product prepares a structured message for communication with another component, but encoding or escaping of the data is either missing or done incorrectly. As a result, the intended structure of the message is not preserved.
remediation_steps: Follow secure coding practices and security guidelines

stage3_hypothesis.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
